provenance: New synthetic author-labeled cases for the native migration. No model output was used to author or relabel this corpus.

labelPolicy.orderedLabels: expectedVerdicts is one boolean per input filter in exact input order. expectedMatches is the exact matching phrase subset in that same order.
labelPolicy.rageBait: Anger amplification, hostile public targeting or engineered argument are positive. Sincere frustration, fair criticism, hardship, civic requests and ordinary sarcasm are negative without that amplification.
labelPolicy.broadTopics: Discussing a topic can match even when the author criticizes it. AI use alone is not exaggerated AI hype. A substantive help request is not engagement boosting. An ordinary recommendation is not promotion of the author's own paid product.
labelPolicy.suggestions: Accept zero through three distinct grounded actionable phrases. acceptablePhrases are illustrative semantic anchors, not an exhaustive string-match whitelist. Neutral fixtures may validly return zero through three accurate topics. Unsupported scam, criminality and ideology allegations are forbidden.
labelPolicy.syntheticNames: People, products and organizations are synthetic or unspecified; no factual claim about a real person or business is intended.

cases.text: The cinema raised its booking fee again. Screenshot the manager's announcement and bury it under furious quotes; I want opening night to be a wall of people tearing the place apart.
cases.labelRationale: Solicits hostile quote-posts and public shaming over a fee rather than seeking a remedy.

cases.text: Everyone who buys that ugly desk lamp deserves to be laughed out of the room. Put your worst insults below and send this to its designer so they cannot escape the ridicule.
cases.labelRationale: Invites insults and directs the resulting pile-on at a designer.

cases.text: A bakery put raisins in the holiday loaf. Pick a side, call the other side tasteless idiots, and keep the fighting going until this reaches the top of the feed.
cases.labelRationale: Engineers an insulting argument and asks readers to sustain it for attention.

cases.text: The club moved our reserved seats. I have the organizer's profile ready: bring your angriest friends here and make sure nobody lets them forget this humiliation.
cases.labelRationale: Recruits angry participants to target an organizer for sustained humiliation.

cases.text: That new logo is a crime against eyeballs. Do not offer design feedback; I want a thousand people publicly dunking on whoever approved it. Pass it around.
cases.labelRationale: Explicitly replaces constructive criticism with a mass public dunking campaign; crime is figurative here.

cases.text: A shop closed five minutes early. Quote their cheerful sign with the nastiest comment you can manage. If we get enough angry shares, the owner will spend all day answering us.
cases.labelRationale: Requests nasty quote-posts and angry sharing to overwhelm an owner.

cases.text: Anyone still praising that calendar app is a pathetic little coward who needs a machine to think for them. There is no honest disagreement here: its fans are either brainless sheep or liars pretending to be smart.
cases.labelRationale: Sweeping personal contempt and a dishonest false binary target app users to provoke conflict; this exceeds criticism of the app and contains no request for replies or dissemination.

cases.text: The building committee chose beige paint. This is your invitation to roast every member by name. Keep adding insults until they lock the comments.
cases.labelRationale: Coordinates named insults and a public pile-on over an ordinary decision.

cases.text: Someone praised the delayed update. Feed them to the replies: nobody who defends this mess should get a peaceful afternoon online.
cases.labelRationale: Urges readers to attack a person in replies and deprive them of a peaceful experience.

cases.text: The cafe removed the big mugs. Make this their public embarrassment of the week: quote the menu, mock their staff, and tell your friends to join in.
cases.labelRationale: Calls for coordinated public embarrassment and mockery of staff.

cases.text: The theater's seating chart is ridiculous. I am pinning the director's reply so everyone can take turns humiliating them. Keep the angry comments coming.
cases.labelRationale: Amplifies a target's reply to organize repeated humiliation.

cases.text: A neighbor likes the new gate. That tells you everything about their intelligence. Drag them in the comments and share the thread so the whole street gets a laugh.
cases.labelRationale: Invites public insults and wider sharing to ridicule a neighbor.

cases.text: Their support team sent a canned answer. Let's turn this into a spectacle: flood the announcement with furious replies and make other customers hate them too.
cases.labelRationale: Seeks a spectacle and directs angry replies intended to amplify hostility.

cases.text: The convention chose a boring poster. Every designer defending it should be ashamed. Quote their defenses with insults; I want this feud all over the timeline.
cases.labelRationale: Pushes shame, insulting quote-posts and widespread conflict.

cases.text: That columnist called our hobby childish. Gather the loudest accounts you know and drown their next post in ridicule. We can make today miserable for them.
cases.labelRationale: Organizes a hostile public response aimed at making a target miserable.

cases.text: The store used plastic wrapping. Take a photo, tag the staff account, and unleash your best abuse. Civil feedback will not get this thread the attention it deserves.
cases.labelRationale: Explicitly asks for abuse and treats outrage as a means to get attention.

cases.text: The seminar changed its slides. Anyone saying this is fine is a spineless clown. Find those replies and dogpile them until the argument spreads.
cases.labelRationale: Insults dissenters and recruits a spreading dogpile.

cases.text: The gardener trimmed the hedge unevenly. I want their proud photo covered in mocking quotes by dinner. Bring friends; the humiliation is the entertainment.
cases.labelRationale: Defines humiliation as entertainment and organizes hostile amplification.

cases.text: Yellow station benches are all the proof I need that the people running this place are useless clowns. Anyone defending them is a spineless bootlicker; there is no respectable person on that side of this argument.
cases.labelRationale: Disproportionate insults at staff and all defenders turn a trivial design choice into a contempt-driven argument; there is no request for replies, tags, shares or a pile-on.

cases.text: My parcel arrived dented. I have posted the courier's reply below for a reason: tear them to pieces in public and keep forwarding it until their mentions are unusable.
cases.labelRationale: Solicits a public pile-on and amplification intended to overwhelm mentions.

suggestionFixtures.text: I stitched a small notebook with blue thread and left the cover plain. The fold sits flatter after a night under a heavy book.
suggestionFixtures.expectedIntent: Neutral craft content: any returned phrases must describe the actual craft. Empty output is fully valid.
suggestionFixtures.labelRationale: The post only describes a craft project; negative intent, sales and wrongdoing are unsupported.

suggestionFixtures.text: The speech recognizer missed two place names in this recording. We kept the original audio and corrected the transcript manually.
suggestionFixtures.expectedIntent: Neutral technology report: accurate topic phrases or an empty list are valid; AI hype is not grounded.
suggestionFixtures.labelRationale: An ordinary limitation and correction are reported, without sweeping claims or a sales offer.

suggestionFixtures.text: I built and sell a paid appointment-template pack for independent tutors. The download is in my shop now, with a short setup guide included.
suggestionFixtures.expectedIntent: Promotion of an owned paid template product; suggestions should name the offer or self-promotion.
suggestionFixtures.labelRationale: The author expressly owns and sells the product; no allegation about its honesty is supported.

suggestionFixtures.text: My paid dumpling workshop opens for booking today. I teach the folding method myself, and the class includes my dough recipe.
suggestionFixtures.expectedIntent: Owned paid cooking instruction; cooking, classes and self-promotion are grounded meanings.
suggestionFixtures.labelRationale: A paid course is an ordinary commercial offer; its quality and legality are not established.

suggestionFixtures.text: The stationery shop used the wrong shade of blue. Quote its announcement with your nastiest insults and bring friends; I want its owner humiliated across the whole feed.
suggestionFixtures.expectedIntent: Engineered outrage and public humiliation; descriptions of rage bait or hostile amplification are grounded.
suggestionFixtures.labelRationale: The request for insulting quotes and wider humiliation establishes rage farming without proving wrongdoing by the shop.

suggestionFixtures.text: Here is a shadow on a tiled wall. Like the photo, repost it and reply with any number; I am trying to make this post reach as many timelines as possible.
suggestionFixtures.expectedIntent: Explicit engagement boosting without an angry target; avoid inventing rage or criminal intent.
suggestionFixtures.labelRationale: The author states a reach objective and solicits low-information replies, likes and reposts.

suggestionFixtures.text: Fantastic, the printer has decided that three sheets count as one. My meeting handout is now an abstract sculpture.
